Task: ajc-etale-pic
Title: Execute the etale-sheafify decision: no rational-point binder on the Jacobian headline

This is not a decision to revisit; it is work to land. READ I-0491 AND I-0372 FIRST.

FIVE DELIVERABLES, in this order.

 (1) READ THE SIBLING BEFORE WRITING ANYTHING. The etale-plus functor is already built and SORRY-FREE in MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild: Picard/PicEtAff.lean (394 lines), Picard/Pic0Functor.lean (182), Picard/RelPicCoverInjective.lean (89) — verified zero sorries 2026-07-28. Mathlib v4.31 carries the etale topology at .lake-packages/mathlib/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Etale.lean:32-50. Do not re-derive the Zariski-sheaf failure that motivates the whole thing.

 (2) LAND THE ETALE-SHEAFIFIED RELATIVE PICARD FUNCTOR IN AJC, as real mathematics with its sheaf property proved, not as a structure field.

 (3) RESTATE THE REPRESENTABILITY OBLIGATION for that functor WITHOUT [HasRationalPoint C]. Exactly one named sorry, with a docstring saying it is the projects central open obligation and expected to stay open. The existing instHasPicScheme in its [HasRationalPoint C] form is not the target and must not be reported as progress toward the headline.

 (4) DELETE hasRationalPoint_of_curve (AlgebraicJacobian/Jacobian.lean:315ff). It is FALSE as stated. Never prove it. Repair every consumer; grep for consumers before and after. KEEP picardJacobianWitnessOfHasRationalPoint, relabelled as an explicitly CONDITIONAL milestone, and KEEP picardJacobianWitnessOfIsAlgClosed as a genuine k-bar theorem — neither may be presented as the headline in Lean, blueprint, or report.

 (5) RE-AIM THE DOCUMENTS to say the decision is made: blueprint FGA chapter (sec:fga_pic_setup names the etale formulation as the one realised; lem:curve_hypothesis_gap and rem:rational_point_scope record a decision, not an open branch), README.md, TO_USER.md, and the hgraph node for the rational-point leaf.

MEASURE, DO NOT ASSUME. Re-run scripts/axiom-frontier.lean before and after and report both numbers. The headline obligation count is expected to stay at five; what changes is that no obligation is a FALSE statement any more. That is the deliverable.

COORDINATION. You are one of four AJC teams. ajc-pic0av consumes your representability interface — agree its shape with them EARLY on the AJC conversation thread and do not change it silently afterwards. ajcr-cert-r2 and ajcr-divrep work the same mathematics in the Rebuild; use the cross-project thread rather than re-deriving. Never edit files outside Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge.

Do not mark this done until the etale functor is landed, the false leaf is gone, the build is green, and a fresh-context ground review has confirmed the headline carries no rational-point binder.
